title: Government air-to-air FLIR expert's email on Gimbal rotation
place_text: Off the US East Coast (Gimbal video)

tellings.quote: I'll read it. The object in the video is definitely maneuvering causing the appearance of rotation.
I mean, Mick, we were on on the call with the AT Flare expert. He says, "This is quote bizarre. I've never seen anything like this."
tellings.difference: Quotes the expert on a call calling the video 'bizarre' and unlike anything he had seen, rather than reading an email about the object maneuvering.
tellings.link_reason: Both concern the government ATFLIR expert whom merrick consulted about the Gimbal video and who judged the object anomalous.

plain: An analyst named Marik von Rennenkampff says a government expert on infrared targeting cameras looked at the Gimbal video. That is a Navy infrared clip, filmed off the US East Coast, of an object that seems to rotate. Von Rennenkampff reads out an email in which the expert writes that "the object in the video is definitely maneuvering causing the appearance of rotation." Elsewhere in the same debate he tells it differently, saying the expert called the video "bizarre" on a call, "I've never seen anything like this." He makes the point to Mick West, a UFO skeptic who argues the rotation comes from the camera, because if the expert is right, the object itself was moving.
